units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__ is a __TRILIUM_PH_1__Script API__TRILIUM_PH_2__ showcase present in the __TRILIUM_PH_3__demo notes__TRILIUM_PH_4__.

By adding __TRILIUM_PH_0__ as a __TRILIUM_PH_1__promoted attribute__TRILIUM_PH_2__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_3__template__TRILIUM_PH_4__ from which __TRILIUM_PH_5__day notes__TRILIUM_PH_6__ are created, you can aggregate the data and plot weight change over time.

The __TRILIUM_PH_0__ note in the screenshot above is of the type __TRILIUM_PH_1__. That type of note doesn't have any useful content itself. Instead it is a placeholder where a __TRILIUM_PH_2__script__TRILIUM_PH_3__ can render its output.

Scripts for __TRILIUM_PH_0__ are defined in a __TRILIUM_PH_1__relation__TRILIUM_PH_2__ called __TRILIUM_PH_3__. In this example, it's the __TRILIUM_PH_4__'s child __TRILIUM_PH_5__. The Implementation consists of two __TRILIUM_PH_6__code notes__TRILIUM_PH_7__ that contain some HTML and JavaScript respectively, which load all the notes with a __TRILIUM_PH_8__ attribute and display their values in a chart.
To actually render the chart, we're using a third party library called __TRILIUM_PH_0__chart.js__TRILIUM_PH_1__which is imported as an attachment, since it's not built into Trilium.
